viewport_notes: mobile: checkout CTA reachable. either page or drawer cart.

checks.rule: no spacing collisions or overlapping elements; nothing wraps or overflows the viewport (flex rows, long text); typography cascade intact (no wrong font/size/weight bleeding into a section); if the surface renders dark, text stays readable
line items (image+title+price+qty), subtotal/total, and a clear checkout button all present + legible
checkout CTA is the clear primary action; totals prominent
if empty, an intentional branded empty state (not a broken/blank shell)
no missing-image placeholders, no Liquid errors, no Lorem/[CLAIM] text
